title: DraftMessageEvent
description: data of the SSE events of POST /drafts/{draftId}/messages; the SSE event name is the type. Order: reply*, then (unless the turn was the AI's opening) replied and source, or error at any point; always done last. The event name tells them apart (reply and replied share a shape), hence anyOf.

reply.title: DraftReplyEvent
reply.description: event: reply. The next piece of the AI's answer.

replied.title: DraftRepliedEvent
replied.description: event: replied. The answer is complete (its whole text); the notes update starts.

source.title: DraftSourceEvent
source.description: event: source. The notes after this turn: changed = indexes of new or rewritten sentences (highlighted), questions for missing information, similar names to confirm as one entity (§8).

error.title: DraftErrorEvent
error.description: event: error. The reply or the notes update failed; code maps to a UI state (LLM_* codes, NOTES_CHANGED when the user edited the notes meanwhile).
